Use it after search_texts, or from a vote's 'billId'. Content is in French unless 'language' asks for

tools.description: List the amendments tabled on a bill, most recently tabled first: number, article, author, group, fate and tabling date. tools.name: list_bill_reasons
tools.description: List the reasons that citizens of the application give to one opinion on a bill: 'stance' is FOR, AGAINST or ABSTENTION, and the reasons come most shared first, each with how many citizens share it. Anonymous: no author is ever returned. These are opinions of the application's users, neither an offi

tools.name: get_bill_long_summary
tools.description: Get the long, plain-language summary of a bill. Use it when the user wants to understand what a bill does and the short summary of get_bill is not enough. In French unless 'language' asks for another language of the Union (translated on demand).

tools.name: list_bill_decrees
tools.description: List the implementing decrees of a promulgated law, with the link that was used to find them. Use it to answer 'has this law been applied?'. Empty when the bill is not a promulgated law. Open one with get_decree.

tools.name: get_text
tools.description: Read one version of the text of a bill (filed text, committee text, adopted text...): its wording ('fullText'), explanatory memorandum, summaries and the versions it can be compared with (see compare_texts). Use it when the user asks what a bill SAYS. The wording of a law is long: it is returned in

tools.name: compare_texts
tools.description: Paragraph-level comparison between a text and another version of the same bill, always from the older to the newer. Use it to see what an amendment process or a Senate reading changed. Without 'otherTextId' the previous version of the procedure is used; an error says when no comparison is possible.

tools.name: get_decree
tools.description: Get one decree or ordinance published in the Journal officiel: visas, notice, articles, signatories and the laws it applies. Use it after search_texts (kind DECREE) or list_bill_decrees. Long articles are cut: the 'truncated' field says so.

tools.name: get_eu_official_text
tools.description: Official EU legislative text. With 'billId' alone: lists the official versions of a European bill (proposal, Parliament position, adopted act) with the languages each exists in (empty for French bills). With 'textId': reads that version as XHTML in the requested 'language' (with a fallback language,

tools.name: list_votes
tools.description: List the roll-call votes (scrutins publics) of one chamber, newest first by default: National Assembly (default), Senate or European Parliament. Returns each vote's id, title, date, outcome and totals. Use it to find 'the vote on X' (search by title with 'q'), then open it with get_vote for the tall

tools.name: get_vote
tools.description: Get one roll-call vote: result, totals, the text voted on and the tallies per political group (for, against, abstentions). Use it to answer 'how did group X vote on Y?'. For how each individual member voted use list_vote_member_votes; for the text voted on use get_vote_text_context.

tools.name: list_vote_member_votes
tools.description: List how each member of the chamber voted in a roll call (for, against, abstention, non-voting), with their political group. Only roll calls with 'nominal' true have it. A chamber has hundreds of members: this is PAGINATED, 25 per page; use 'page' to read on, and prefer get_vote when only group tota

tools.name: list_vote_amendments
tools.description: List the amendment(s) an amendment vote was about, with author, wording and justification. Use it when a vote's kind is AMENDMENT and the user asks what the amendment said. Empty for other votes.

tools.name: get_amendment
tools.description: Get one amendment of a bill, tabled in the National Assembly or the Senate ('chamber'): author, group, article amended, fate (outcome: ADOPTED, REJECTED, FELL, WITHDRAWN, NOT_MOVED, PENDING), dates, the amended wording and its justification as HTML, the bill it belongs to and the roll-call votes tha

tools.name: get_vote_text_context
tools.description: Get the bill, the text and the summaries of what a vote was about. Use it to explain a vote in plain words after get_vote. tools.description: Find people of the public registry: deputies, senators, MEPs, ministers, presidents and public figures, as well as political content creators (video makers, media outlets, magazines, columnists; kind=CONTENT_CREATOR, parliamentarians included) and candidates in the 2024 French legislative election (

tools.name: get_person
tools.description: Get one person: biography, public contact details, mandates and political group memberships over time; 'contentCreator' and 'contentFormat' say whether and how the person publishes political content; 'candidacies' lists the rounds of the 2024 legislative election the person stood in (nuance attribut

tools.name: get_person_votes
tools.description: List the roll-call votes of a parliamentarian with their position (for, against, abstention, absent), newest first. Use it to answer 'how did X vote?'. Default kinds: whole texts, motions and others; pass kind=AMENDMENT or ARTICLE for finer votes. Paginated.

tools.name: list_person_proposals
tools.description: List the bills and resolutions a parliamentarian filed as author or co-signed, with their identifiers. Use it for 'what did X propose?'. Open one with get_text. Paginated.

tools.name: get_person_activity
tools.description: Get a parliamentarian's participation in roll-call votes and how often they vote with their group. Use it for 'is X active / loyal to their group?'. An error says when the person has no parliamentary mandate.

tools.name: list_groups
tools.description: List the political groups sitting in a chamber (National Assembly by default, Senate or European Parliament), with their id and acronym. tools.name: list_themes
tools.description: List the themes (policy domains) that classify bills and votes. Labels are in French. Use it to know the vocabulary a bill's or a vote's 'themes' come from.

tools.name: list_governments
tools.description: List the governments of the French Republic, most recent first, with their Prime Minister and dates. Search with 'q'. Open one with get_government. Paginated.

tools.name: get_government
tools.description: Get a government of the French Republic and its members with their function and dates.

findings.title: Anomalously long tool description
findings.detail: Description of "search_texts" is 2088 chars, far longer than this server's median (316). Overlong descriptions are a common place to bury instructions.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_amendment, get_vote_text_context · Private data: search_texts, get_person · Public sink: list_bill_reasons.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_amendment, get_vote_text_context · Private data: search_texts, get_person · Public sink: list_bill_reasons

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
